messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 1 May 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate debrief: Aman Gupta (SWE) — interviewer scores and resume

Hi team,

Following up from yesterday's loop — Aman Gupta (via Priya at TalentMatch) completed onsite interviews. Raw interviewer scores attached (interview_rubric.xlsx) and resume attached (Aman_Gupta_Resume.pdf). Summary:

- System design: 3/5 (solid approach but missed tradeoff clarity)
- Algorithms: 4/5 (good problem solving; edge cases noted)
- Leadership/ownership (behavioral): 4/5
- Take-home assignment: 4/5 (clean implementation; some perf edge cases)

Panel average: 3.75/5 — recommending SWE II (band 4) per our rubric. Marcus, one note flagged you wanted more leadership examples — I called that out in the panel notes.

Next steps: Marcus to confirm if he wants to move forward to offer at SWE II or request a calibration for Senior. Candidate timeline: Priya said Aman needs a decision by next Friday (2025-05-09) to coordinate other offers.

Attachments: Aman_Gupta_Resume.pdf, interview_rubric.xlsx

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 May 2025 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate debrief: Aman Gupta (SWE) — interviewer scores and resume

Thanks Vivek — I reviewed the rubric and panel notes. I disagree with the SWE II recommendation. Two interviewers gave very high marks on product sense and cross-team influence, which I believe are the primary signals for Senior here. The raw numeric average hides that distribution.

Can we:
- Pull the specific behavioral quotes that supported the 4/5 leadership marks?
- See which interviewers rated system design lower and why?

I can provide candidate quotes from my session where Aman described leading a cross-functional migration at CloudFizz (details below). That experience maps to impact at scope we expect for Senior.

If we stick to SWE II only, we'll likely lose him to competing offers. I want to request a quick calibration (15–20 min) with one other senior interviewer + Hannah to break the tie.

Hi Marcus, Vivek —

Thanks for the notes. A few process reminders before we escalate:

1) Evidence required for Senior bump: demonstrable scope of impact (multi-team ownership), sustained technical leadership, and influence on architecture or product decisions. Behavioral answers should include specific metrics / outcomes where possible.
2) Rubric tie-breakers: we prioritize leadership evidence over a single high technical score, but both matter. If Marcus can point to specific quotes or a short write-up that maps to our Senior criteria, I can convene a quick calibration panel.

Marcus — can you paste the exact excerpts/quotes and any supporting links (e.g., internal PRs, project summaries, or the take-home assignment link)? If the evidence is compelling, HR will support an expedited calibration with a neutral senior interviewer.

I'll block 20 minutes on Monday/Tuesday for a calibrate if we have evidence.

Monica Patel
Talent Partner, People Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate debrief: Aman Gupta (SWE) — interviewer scores and resume

Monica — thanks. Below are the excerpts from my interview notes and the specific examples Aman shared (verbatim where possible):

- "I led a migration of our realtime event pipeline at CloudFizz to a new processing layer; we reduced downstream lag by 60% and removed a duplicated service — project impacted three product teams."
- "I owned triage and architecture decisions when we hit a production incident; I coordinated cross-team postmortems and rolled two rollbacks within 24 hours to restore service."

Take-home assignment: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/assignment-aman-gt3 — implementation shows design decisions that indicate ownership (setup of observability and rollout plan).

I also pulled short notes from Interviewer 2 & 4 that emphasize cross-team influence. Happy to discuss on Monday — I can present the case in 10 minutes.

Subject: Re: Candidate debrief: Aman Gupta (SWE) — interviewer scores and resume

Team — quick update on timeline and practical options:

- Priya (TalentMatch) confirms Aman needs a decision by EOD Friday 2025-05-09.
- Option A: Proceed with SWE II offer today to secure candidate; include a clear leveling & growth plan and commit to a 6-month re-review for fast promotion if performance matches Marcus's evidence.
- Option B: Convene a 15-min calibration panel (Mon or Tue morning) and attempt to approve Senior before offer. Risk: takes time and may miss Priya's deadline.

Suggested comp framing: base $155k (SWE II) vs Senior baseline $175k. I attached a quick draft comp memo (comp-proposal-draft.pdf) for HR review.

If HR signs off on Option A with the 6-month re-review commitment and a small hiring bonus or sign-on (to bridge), I recommend we lock the candidate. Without the re-review, Marcus, I understand your concern.

Vivek
Head of Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Ramanujan <priya@talentmatch.co>
Date: Thu, 8 May 2025 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Aman Gupta — offer banding decision and candidate message

Team,

Thanks for the input and the evidence, Marcus. I reviewed Marcus's excerpts, the take-home link, and the panel notes. Given the time constraint and the quality of evidence, HR will authorize Option A: extend an offer at SWE II (band 4) with the following commitments to address Marcus's concerns:

1) Offer at SWE II base $155,000 with a $7,500 sign-on bonus (one-time) to reflect market competitiveness.
2) Formal 6-month leveling review: hiring manager to prepare a written promotion packet at 4 months; People Ops will convene a calibration committee at 6 months to assess promotion to Senior if evidence aligns.
3) If the candidate receives a competing Senior offer and withdraws before completion of the 6-month window, we will honor an expedited review for exceptional cases but cannot retroactively increase the initial band.

Vivek / Priya — please use the candidate-facing wording below when you call Aman:

"Hi Aman — we enjoyed meeting you. We'd like to extend an offer at Senior-Track SWE II with a competitive base of $155,000 and a $7,500 sign-on bonus. We also commit to an expedited 6-month promotion review where you'll be evaluated against Senior criteria; Marcus and the team will document the impact milestones. We expect a decision by you by Friday 2025-05-09. Please let us know if you need more time.

Best,
The Redwood Hiring Team"

Marcus — please prepare the 4-month packet template and a short list of measurable milestones we can use for the promotion evaluation. Monica and I will schedule the 6-month calibration now so dates are on the calendar.

Attachements: comp-proposal-draft.pdf

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of People Business Partners
Redwood Inference
